'''Bendeluum''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. Originally [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it eventually became a minor competitor to the nearby megaworld [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]] and had a thriving criminal underworld that influenced every aspect of its commerce. Many of Bendeluum's crime syndicates originated with the [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Description==
Bendeluum was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="GG" /> located in the [[Bendeluum system/Legends|Bendeluum system]], a part of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. It was situated in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The world lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which connected it to the [[Zhanox system/Legends|Zhanox system]] as well as the [[Indellian system/Legends|Indellian system]] of the neighboring [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. Bendeluum was located inside the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]]. There, launching from newly [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] worlds such as Bendeluum, Republic [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] unsuccessfully attempted to discover shortcut [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] through the region's [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]]&mdash;the Ivax and [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebulae]]&mdash;that would better connect the civilizations of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]] and [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiins]] to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="GG" />

Such hyperlanes were ultimately established through the efforts of the entrepreneur [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], and as a result, several worlds along the Corellian Trade Spine, including Bendeluum, were transformed from being sleepy Outer Rim outposts to having multiple busy [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing Bendeluum was re-designated as the Anoat sector.<ref name="GG" />

==Inhabitants==
Bendeluum was a minor competitor to<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;and in many respects a less-active version of&mdash;the nearby megaworld [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]]. The former world's trading markets, which were slightly less profitable than those of Gerrenthum, gave rise to<ref name="GG" /> a thriving criminal underworld.<ref name="TEA" /> Although the criminal activity on Bendeluum did not endanger the lives of visitors to the world, the local crime syndicates&mdash;many of which<ref name="GG" /> were constituted by Nothoiin clans<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;influenced every aspect of commerce there.<ref name="GG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bendeluum was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
